scope: P1-A63 classic Bu Lian Shi, Anxu and Zhuiyi rules, interaction and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网与BWIKI一将成名2012经典步练师（吴3体力，安恤、追忆）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典步练师规则：安恤选择两名手牌数不同的其他角色，由手牌少者获得并展示手牌多者的一张手牌，若展示牌不为黑桃则步练师摸一张；追忆在死亡时可令杀死她的角色之外的一名其他角色摸三张并回复1点体力。该页同时提供574x761经典静态大图。
交叉核对一将成名2012、吴势力、女性、3体力与经典问答：所有其他角色手牌数相同时不能发动安恤；小乔以红颜改变所展示黑桃的有效花色后步练师摸牌；追忆可选择满体力角色；没有伤害来源的死亡不会排除通常意义上的杀死者。
按用户指定概念页区分技能标签、应用状态与触发执行：安恤由玩家在出牌阶段发起，建模为Active；追忆在死亡事件上询问拥有者是否发动，建模为可选Trigger，而非锁定或自动State。

ruleText.anxu: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择两名手牌数不同的其他角色，令其中手牌少的角色先获得手牌多的角色的一张手牌再展示之，然后若以此法展示的牌不为黑桃，你摸一张牌。
ruleText.zhuiyi: 当你死亡时，你可以令除杀死你的角色外的一名其他角色摸三张牌，然后其回复1点体力。

implementation.anxuInteraction: the shared active-skill draft requires exactly two other living targets with unequal public hand counts; the lower-hand receiver alone gets a private prompt containing opaque donor-hand slot ordinals, and the chosen physical card moves through Processing before entering the receiver hand and being publicly revealed
implementation.anxuEffectiveSuit: the revealed card checks EffectiveSuit on the receiver, so classic Hongyan converts a Spade to Heart before deciding whether Bu Lian Shi draws
implementation.zhuiyiInteraction: the dead owner receives one private optional target prompt over frozen living candidates excluding the actual killer; the target draws three before recovering up to one HP, so a full-health target still draws without a fabricated recovery
implementation.deathContinuation: death-skill continuation now records resolved SkillKind values and can sequence Wuhun and Zhuiyi without re-entering an already completed death skill

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: the accepted command prefix reconstructs the selected Anxu target pair, private opaque hand-slot choice, effective-suit result, optional Zhuiyi target or skip, card movements and death-skill continuation
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: rules v111 keeps Anxu and Zhuiyi disabled even when package 1.90.0 is loaded; package 1.89.0 does not register Bu Lian Shi

portrait.attribution: Official classic Bu Lian Shi artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

assertions: Anxu is absent before package 1.90.0 and rules v112, remains once per play phase and rejects equal-hand target pairs in both the engine and WPF confirmation surface
only the lower-hand receiver sees opaque donor-hand slot ordinals; no hidden card id or kind leaks to the owner, donor or observers
the selected physical card moves through Processing, is publicly revealed and checks the receiver's effective suit, including the classic Hongyan Spade-to-Heart FAQ
Zhuiyi is an optional dead-owner trigger that excludes the actual killer while allowing a full-health target to draw three cards and recover zero HP
paused Anxu and Zhuiyi prompts and their completed branches replay exactly from accepted commands
the official portrait, exact classic rule text, Active/Trigger skill rail, active draft, private death prompt and public battle cues render without clipping or binding errors

excludedVariants: Jie Bu Lian Shi and other boundary-breakthrough Anxu or Zhuiyi variants
mobile, self-chess and other-product Bu Lian Shi definitions
automatic Zhuiyi resolution without the dead owner's optional trigger choice
deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
